pages.text: Widens the sweet spot when striking, never wears on your work, and never falls. Forged from Wardsilver, found in tier 2 dungeons.

pages.text: Pour bottles of Quenching Oil into a cauldron (up to three) to make an $(item)Oil Cauldron$(). Quenching in oil never cracks the metal.
